newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO SET UP STATE PROCUREMENTS BODY - DEPMIN.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO SET UP STATE PROCUREMENTS BODY - DEPMIN.

text.p: Greece will set up a state procurements body to ensure transparency and efficiency in handling taxpayers' money, Deputy Development Minister Michael Chrysochoidis said.
"The body's purpose will be to express views on precurements, research markets, list suppliers, provided advice and data and check the final result," he told a conference organised by the Economist.
A draft law outlining the set up and operation of the organisation, which will be named Evnomia, is ready and will be presented to parliament soon, he said.

"This way, we achieve the desired restructuring and transparency, as well as the efficient handling of the Greek taxpayer's money," Chrysochoidis said. --Dina Kyriakidou, Intercontinental Newsroom +301 3311813
